detail.longDescription: ChatGPT dots don't come as a surprise. Always-on agents have been the next frontier AI since OpenClaw caused a run on Mac minis back in January 2026. OpenAI even hired OpenClaw's developer, Peter Steinberger. And OpenAI isn't alone in this: Meta has Muse, Gemini has Spark, and Anthropic is presumably developing something else pretty similar.
